## 2026-05-18 - [Missing escapeHTML function]
**Vulnerability:** XSS vulnerability through lack of input sanitization
**Learning:** We need to sanitize user input when generating dynamic HTML directly in client-side code to prevent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS).
**Prevention:** Implement and use an escapeHTML function to sanitize text input before inserting it into innerHTML.
## 2026-06-29 - Fixed XSS vulnerability in persona card rendering
**Vulnerability:** A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability was found in `index.html` where unvalidated JSON data generated by LLMs (`data.persona`, `data.product_chosen`, `data.quote`, etc.) was injected directly into the DOM using `innerHTML` template literals without escaping.
**Learning:** Even if data comes from "trusted" models or LLMs, it must be sanitized before rendering because models can hallucinate malicious inputs or be subject to prompt injection. `escapeHTML` was defined but not utilized properly for all inserted variables in the rendering code.
**Prevention:** Always use `escapeHTML()` when interpolating any string fields into an `innerHTML` block. Ensure numeric values are properly handled, though numbers aren't typically an XSS risk on their own. Avoid using `innerHTML` if possible; prefer `textContent` or similar safer methods.
